name: loopd
description: Synchronous multi-phase dev task runner for Claude Code — planning → implementation → review in a single window with workspace-isolated git worktrees.

plugins.name: loopd
plugins.description: Run /dev-task to kick off a planning → implementation → review pipeline in the current Claude Code window. Synchronous, workspace-isolated execution — no daemon, no Slack bridge.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub issue resolution loop (experimental). Lead Claude thread + 7 teammates + auto-invoked loopd /dev-task. Run /orchestrator to start.

plugins.name: qa-check
plugins.description: PR-level QA agent (experimental). Generates L3 browser QA scenarios from PR diff + ticket intent, runs them as Playwright specs, and produces a merge-decision evidence report for human review. Run /qa-check <PR|commit>.
